description: Use this when the user wants government contracts search, federal contract awards by NAICS code, contracts expiring soon or federal market research. Queries live public award records and makes a multi-sheet Excel report with recipient and agency totals. At least one search filter; up to 300 rows, dates from 2007-10-01 through today UTC, prime contracts or IDVs. Totals cover returned rows; period obligations are separate aggregates. Do not use for open solicitations, bids, subcontracts or classified awards.

agencies.description: Up to 5 values, each up to 150 characters. Example: ["VA"].

award_category.description: Award group, default contracts. Example: idvs uses last date to order for the ending window.

end_date.description: Last action date, no later than today UTC; default today UTC. Example: 2026-10-01.

keywords.description: Up to 5 values, each up to 50 characters. Example: ["janitorial"].

max_results.description: Maximum award rows, 1 to 300, default 100. Example: 200.

naics_codes.description: Up to 10 values, each up to 6 characters. Example: ["541512"].

psc_codes.description: Up to 10 values, each up to 4 characters. Example: ["S201"].

recipients.description: Up to 10 values, each up to 80 characters. Example: ["Booz Allen"].

start_date.description: First action date, YYYY-MM-DD, from 2007-10-01. Default end minus 365 days. Example: 2025-10-01.

states.description: Up to 10 values, each up to 2 characters. Example: ["TX"].

name: search_contract_awards

largest_amount.description: USD with two decimal places, for example $150.03 or -$40,013.22.

total.description: USD with two decimal places, for example $150.03 or -$40,013.22.
